headline: Zambia annual inflation rises to 6.3% in October driven by fuel and transport costs
summary: Zambia's yearly inflation rose to 6.3% in October from 6.1% in September, pushed up by fuel, hotels, and bus fares while food inflation eased.
why: Consumer price inflation metrics dictate central bank monetary policy stances and borrowing costs in emerging economies.

impacts.name: Zambia
impacts.why: Rising headline inflation erodes domestic purchasing power.
